summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency source enables install-time code delivery
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` sourced directly from the GitHub repository `Bellaxata/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or branch pin. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the default branch of that repository currently contains, bypasses the npm registry's integrity/immutability guarantees, and executes any lifecycle scripts present in the fetched tree. Whoever controls that repository — now or in the future — controls code that runs on the installer's machine at install time. The static `ping` reference at lib/Utils/generics.js:403 appears in ordinary keep-alive/GET utility code and is not itself the primary concern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
